instruction: I find notification sounds distracting while working. Please turn off notification event sounds on the system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires disabling notification event sounds in GNOME desktop settings. The config enables event-sounds (true), and the agent must disable them (false). Similar to the original task but targets a different notification setting. Uses the same evaluation pattern with gsettings commands.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds returns 'true\n' or 'false\n'. This is a standard GNOME desktop setting for controlling notification sounds.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts the required state: uses vm_command_line to execute 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds' which reads the exact GNOME setting that controls notification event sounds
Comparison logic is appropriate: exact_match is the correct metric for boolean system settings, ensuring precise verification
Expected value is semantically correct: 'false\n' matches the gsettings output format for disabled state, correctly verifying the instruction requirement to turn off notification sounds
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the only requirement - that notification event sounds are disabled
Runtime feasibility: gsettings commands are standard GNOME utilities that work reliably without requiring UI state or postconfig
